description: This file defines a custom attribute [TestCategory] for categorizing tests in xUnit, along with a discoverer class [CategoryDiscoverer] that retrieves the category trait from the attribute. It serves as a replacement for MSTest's [TestCategory] attribute to facilitate test filtering by category in xUnit.

classes.name: TestCategoryAttribute
classes.description: Custom attribute to specify test category, mimicking MSTest's [TestCategory]

classes.name: CategoryDiscoverer
classes.description: Class implementing ITraitDiscoverer to extract category trait from [TestCategory] attribute

methods.name: GetTraits
methods.description: Method to extract the category trait from the attribute info
